source.stem:
A man can either take an escalator or a lift to travel up between two floors in a hotel.
The escalator takes 20 seconds to carry the man between the two floors. The useful work done against gravity is W. The useful power developed is P.
The lift takes 30 seconds to carry the same man between the same two floors.
How much useful work against gravity is done by the lift, and how much useful power is developed by the lift?

options.text: more than W less than P

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: thin glass plate is the same as its neighbouring term in this chapter, so the decision does not change.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Judge from the most visible feature in the figure, not from the mechanism's test.

intelligence.enrichment: A thin glass plate lets the light beam pass as it is, a convex lens converges the light falling on it, and a concave lens diverges the light falling on it. transparent optical element shape determines whether transmitted parallel beams pass unchanged, converge, or diverge The learner predicts whether a thin glass plate, convex lens, or concave lens passes, converges, or diverges multiple parallel beams. Any transparent object bends parallel light beams, so even a thin glass plate must converge or diverge the beams.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Light: mirrors and lenses. The student must decide: Predict whether a thin glass plate, convex lens, or concave lens will pass, converge, or diverge multiple parallel light beams.
